TIMEKPR_LOGLEVEL.description: Logging level of the timekpr (1 - normal, 2 - debug, 3 - extra debug)

TIMEKPR_SAVE_TIME.description: Time in seconds for saving user time control file

TIMEKPR_TRACK_INACTIVE.description: Whether to account sessions which are inactive (locked screen, user switched away from desktop, etc.). New users inherit this value.

TIMEKPR_TERMINATION_TIME.description: Time interval in seconds prior to assign user a termination sequence. 15 seconds before time ends nothing can be done to avoid killing a session. This is also the time before initiating a termination sequence if user has logged in inappropriate time.

TIMEKPR_FINAL_WARNING_TIME.description: Time interval in seconds prior to termination of user sessions when timekpr will send continuous final warnings (countdown) until the actual termination.

TIMEKPR_FINAL_NOTIFICATION_TIME.description: Time interval in seconds prior to termination of user sessions when timekpr will send one final warning about time left.

TIMEKPR_SESSION_TYPES_CTRL.description: Semicolon-separated list of session types timekpr will track.

TIMEKPR_SESSION_TYPES_EXCL.description: Semicolon-separated list of session types timekpr will ignore explicitly.

TIMEKPR_USERS_EXCL.description: Semicolon-separated list of users timekpr will ignore explicitly.

TIMEKPR_CONFIG_DIR.description: Runtime directory for timekpr user configuration files.

TIMEKPR_WORK_DIR.description: Runtime directory for timekpr time control files.

TIMEKPR_SHARED_DIR.description: Directory for shared files (images, gui definitions, etc.).

TIMEKPR_PLAYTIME_ENHANCED_ACTIVITY_MONIT.description: Whether PlayTime activity monitor will use process command line, including arguments, for monitoring processes (by default only uses the process name).
